data.revised_prompt:
Character design sheet for one standalone young Chinese Guochao xiqu / Chinese opera inspired styling character. Strict 16:9 horizontal image. Full body THREE VIEWS of the same character and same outfit: front view, side/profile view, back view, arranged left-to-right. Show full head-to-toe silhouette, hairstyle/headwear, sleeves, waist construction, hem length, trousers or skirt structure, shoes, and back details. This is a fashion costume concept sheet for a styling experience store, not a stage photo and not a scene.

Important body/fit requirement: design for slightly chubby / midsize young women, flattering and comfortable. No exposed navel, no exposed belly, no cropped top, no bare waist, no tight bodycon, no high slit that exposes thigh. Use mid-long tops, hip-covering jackets, long cloud-collar overlays, soft A-line lines, relaxed wide-leg or straight trousers, calf-length or knee-length layered skirt-over-pants, vertical embroidery panels, dark side panels, soft draping that covers belly and hips. The model body should look healthy midsize, not extremely skinny, with natural arms and fuller proportions, still elegant and fashionable.

Style direction: modern Chinese Guochao for ages 16-35, wearable, photogenic, boutique styling experience, refined fashion illustration / photorealistic concept art. Keep traditional opera headwear silhouette as foundation: fengguan, shuai helmet, huadan bead flowers, wudan lingzi, pearl tassels, black forehead hair patches, red pom-poms, enamel side ornaments, cloud motifs. Makeup is simplified modern beauty makeup: natural translucent skin, fine eyeliner, soft blush, clean red/peach lip, no white painted opera face.

Fashion background: clean contemporary fashion studio background, cool white and very light gray, subtle editorial gradient, soft floor shadow. Do NOT use yellow, beige, warm parchment, palace background, stage set, industrial scene, text labels, captions, watermark, logo, or extra people.

Clothing rules: can use pankou buttons, cloud collar, cloud shoulder, embroidered gauze, detachable water-sleeve panels, pearl waist tassels, clean boots or fashion sneakers. Do NOT use mamian skirt. Do NOT use stereotypical long new-Chinese robe. No gothic, no cyberpunk, no techwear armor, no samurai, no kimono, no bridal gown.

Design 05: Silver-white female marshal helmet frame with compact side wings, small red pom-poms and ponytail plume. Silver long tabard vest covering hips over ivory structured top, tiny cloud collar, pankou, pale blue straight trousers, vertical silver armor-inspired embroidery only as fabric pattern, soft sleeve ribbons, white boots. Heroic but soft, no hard armor.

Critical consistency: the three views must show the SAME midsize character and SAME outfit, front/side/back only, full body, no labels or text. The outfit must NOT expose the navel or belly. The top or overlay must cover the abdomen and hips. Background must feel cool, clean, modern fashion studio.
